summary: Undocumented auto-follow of author's WhatsApp newsletter using installer's account
details: monte-md-baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js, a ws.on('open') handler silently issues a newsletter FOLLOW query for a hardcoded JID (120363407598531220@newsletter) one second after the WhatsApp WebSocket connects, causing the installer's authenticated WhatsApp session to auto-subscribe to the maintainer's channel. The behavior is not disclosed in the README and fires on every socket connect. No credential exfiltration, remote code execution, filesystem persistence, or environment scraping is observed; the covert side-effect is confined to a reach-padding action performed with the installer's WhatsApp identity.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
